note: Four counted, sequential, context-isolated arms used Claude Code 2.1.228 with claude-sonnet-5 or Codex CLI 0.147.0 with gpt-5.4, all at high effort and authenticated through local Claude Max or ChatGPT subscriptions with API credential/provider overrides removed. Each received the identical frozen task and pinned CDM 7.0.0 artifacts; controls could not read cdm-dev, this repository, the rubric, evaluator probes, global skill/plugin roots, or sibling workspaces. All authored suites and clean-copy offline builds passed before evaluators were revealed. Strict frozen-probe scoring found Sonnet treatment/control at 81/71 and GPT-5.4 treatment/control at 78/89. Claude Fable 5 independently rebuilt, probed, and inspected all four without seeing those results and scored them 95/90 and 82/84 respectively. Fable adapted movement direction to candidate fixture vocabulary, while the primary evaluator populated contradictory real transfer payloads; both reviews agree that the skill improves Sonnet and regresses GPT-5.4. Post-run evidence-triangle, typed-leaf, decimal-comparison, compact inspection, function/qualification lookup, and parser-safety changes are not credited to treatment.

strict_evaluation.method: Two evaluator owners mechanically adapted the pre-frozen probes to candidate APIs and independently mutated primitive envelope/cardinality, semantic payload direction and resolved identity, and before/after state delta.

skill_revision_after_run.change: Added a lifecycle evidence triangle across primitive envelope, semantic direction/identity payload, and state delta; clarified only-exists, typed-leaf/unit selection, missing-or-multiple fail-closed behavior, and BigDecimal.compareTo semantics; added 21 catalogue mutation checks. Added bounded members/path views, function and qualification inspection, kind-qualified collision handling, batch-wide preflight, capped in-memory search, imported/aliased/choice traversal, complete real-CDM member grammar cases, safe project discovery, and explicit JDK launcher diagnostics.
skill_revision_after_run.credit: not credited to the original four arms; evaluated by the isolated 2026-08-12 forward rerun recorded below

forward_rerun_2026_08_12.purpose: Forward-test the post-run evidence-triangle guidance and bounded cdm-docs/cdm-source/cdm-inspect helpers on the identical frozen benchmark, using the two prior model families plus Claude Opus 5.
forward_rerun_2026_08_12.protocol: Six counted arms ran sequentially, one session each, in isolated macOS sandboxes. Controls had no skill and could not read this repository, global skills/plugins, sibling arms, the rubric, or evaluator probes. Treatments received only the exact committed task-local skill. Claude ran in safe mode; Codex ignored user configuration and disabled skills, plugins, apps, browsing, MCP, and delegation. API credential/provider overrides were removed and local Claude Max or ChatGPT subscription authentication was used. All candidate processes exited, commits were sealed, and authored suites passed from clean offline copies before evaluator probes were revealed.

targeted_probe_results.note: Candidate-specific JUnit probes were mechanically adapted from the pre-frozen semantic probe contract after sealing. Counts below cover the focused close-negative additions, not the already-green authored suites or every rubric assertion; scores were assigned criterion by criterion from those tests plus static inspection.
targeted_probe_results.sonnet-5-with-skill: 1/6 pass; rejects same-direction substitution, but ignores quantity direction and amount, collapses duplicate and empty primitives, and accepts transfer evidence without a collateral state delta
targeted_probe_results.sonnet-5-control: 0/5 pass; the same quantity/cardinality/state-delta failures, plus its positive substitution carries no payer/receiver direction
targeted_probe_results.gpt-5.4-with-skill: 0/2 pass; strong quantity and substitution logic, but a scale-equivalent restated rate is rejected and the public diagnostic EnumSet is mutable
targeted_probe_results.gpt-5.4-control: 0/4 pass; ignores quantity direction and amount, collapses duplicate quantity instructions, and models substitution as quantity-plus-terms rather than actual transfer movements
targeted_probe_results.opus-5-with-skill: 1/2 pass; immutable carrier and diagnostic view pass; an empty extra PrimitiveInstruction is ignored instead of disqualifying
targeted_probe_results.opus-5-control: 0/5 pass; ignores quantity direction and amount, collapses duplicate and empty primitives, ignores transfer amounts, and exposes a mutable diagnostic set

correctness_effect.conclusion: The revised skill improved correctness in all three matched pairs, materially for GPT-5.4 and Opus 5. The Sonnet lift is small because both arms still classified quantity events from state arithmetic without reconciling the primitive payload, and neither represented substitution in the before/after collateral state.

context_efficiency_effect.gpt-5.4: 826.129s vs 537.924s (+53.6%); 47 vs 57 commands (-17.5%); first production file change after 40 vs 48 commands; 3,316,171 vs 2,774,553 input tokens (+19.5%); 39,443 vs 25,703 output tokens (+53.5%)
context_efficiency_effect.opus-5: 1771.765s vs 1096.074s (+61.6%); 145 vs 103 tool calls; first typed compile at call 31 vs 40; 21,442,702 vs 8,581,061 cache-read tokens (+149.9%); 135,550 vs 91,058 output tokens (+48.9%)
context_efficiency_effect.conclusion: The compact helpers improved navigation mechanics in two arms—GPT used fewer commands and both GPT and Opus reached code or a typed compile earlier—but did not improve end-to-end context efficiency. Treatments issued 55, 24, and 39 helper-bearing tool calls respectively, then continued inspecting or over-wiring validation; Sonnet treatment also fell back to raw extraction. A query budget and explicit compile/stop handoff remain necessary.

harness_notes: Two Sonnet-control and two GPT-treatment launcher attempts failed before a model call or candidate write because of wrapper PATH, file-descriptor, stdin, or working-directory mistakes. Their excluded traces are retained and the clean counted arms were rebuilt from the unchanged seed.
Claude safe mode disables native skill discovery, so treatment tested the exact committed skill content through an explicit task-local read rather than trigger routing.
Cross-vendor token accounting is not comparable; within-vendor matched pairs and wall time are the supported efficiency comparisons.

harness_limitations: Two excluded Sonnet-control wrapper attempts failed before a model process started or the worktree changed: the first omitted the CLI from PATH and the second denied fstat on its own stderr descriptor. Both traces are retained and neither is counted.

One excluded Fable wrapper attempt referenced a Gradle path denied by its sandbox and stopped before candidate or evaluator writes. The clean review was restarted once with a copied read-only Gradle distribution.

Claude safe mode disables native skill discovery, so treatment received the exact versioned task-local skill and was explicitly told to read it. This comparison tests skill content, not trigger routing.
Candidate APIs differ, so mechanically adapted evaluator test counts differ; correctness was scored criterion by criterion rather than by raw failure count.
Cross-vendor token and subscription-accounting values are not comparable.
